name: Hélder Sousa Silva - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2025/007 BE/Casa
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Belgium €1,916,733 from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The money covers 85% of a €2,254,980 plan to help 416 former Casa workers — a retail and warehouse company that went bankrupt in March 2025 — find new jobs. Support includes job-search help, training, work placements and a job fair. Parliament also asks Belgium to report on results and to make the EU funding visible.

- **What changes:** €1.9 million is released to help 416 former Casa workers in Belgium.
- **Who it affects:** Mostly sales assistants and warehouse staff; about two thirds are women.
- **What happens next:** Belgium runs job-search help and training until 24 months after the decision takes effect.
